description: This file contains test scripts for verifying various git pull options and behaviors. It sets up repositories, runs git pull with different parameters, and checks the outcomes. It is used for testing the correctness of git pull functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, runs the specified commands, and checks the outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the provided output or error streams are empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Confirms that the previous command failed as expected.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified message or from a specific directory.

methods.name: test_ref_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific git reference or file is missing.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a certain path does not exist.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output or error streams.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup routines after tests are run.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files to ensure they are identical.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up git hook scripts for testing.
